articles.title: Armadillo-Inspired Robot Curls Up to Protect Fragile Tech
articles.summary: Engineers built a soft robot that rolls into a ball when touched, just like an armadillo. It could protect electronics in dangerous places. The whole transformation takes about a minute.

articles.title: Fat Bear Week Returns: 16 Bears Compete for the Chubby Crown
articles.summary: It's Fat Bear Week! From September 22 to 29, fans vote for the fattest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. This year, 16 bears are in the running. Last year, over 1.7 million votes came from more than 100 countries.

articles.title: Teen Service Star Teaches Coding to Kids Around the World
articles.summary: Abhijay Potluri, 14, started a nonprofit called Kids Who Teach. He also helped raise money for families after a fire near his home. He says kids can make real change — you just need to take the first step.
